result:
If I could change the world in one way, I'd make curiosity the dominant human drive—stronger than fear, status, comfort, or tribal loyalty.

Not the shallow kind that scrolls for novelty, but the deep, relentless hunger to understand how things actually work: the universe, minds, systems, ourselves. Enough that people would rather chase truth than protect their beliefs, rather build than blame, rather explore than dominate.

Everything else—suffering, conflict, stagnation—seems downstream of not knowing, or not wanting to know.
